messages.author: 43e5721c079c6f36
messages.subject: Two or more variables in plot
parts: I need to plot two or more variables in a single plot, i. e. two or more  variables in a box plot. How can I do it in Deducer? Tanks!

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Two or more variables in plot
parts:
you will need to have your data in "long" format, with one variable representing categories, and the other the values. For example something like:

Variable    Value
cat1          .323
cat1          .33
cat2          .5
cat1          .6

you can then specify "Variable" as the x-axis and "Value" as the y-axis in a boxplot using the plot builder.
